meta.title: Possibly Compromised Users (7d)
meta.desc: Alerts from the last 7 days that indicate possible user account compromise. Excludes phishing delivery and endpoint malware alerts.

input.query: let lookback = 7d; let nameMatches = dynamic(['risky user','risky sign','sign-in from','sign in from','leaked credential','password spray','mfa fatigue','multi-factor authentication fatigue','atypical travel','impossible travel','anonymous ip','anonymous proxy','unfamiliar sign','unfamiliar location','unfamiliar properties','token theft','primary refresh token','aitm','adversary-in-the-middle','account takeover','suspicious inbox','inbox forwarding','inbox manipulation','suspicious oauth','consent to application','mass download','unusual file download','unusual administrative activity','suspicious addition to privileged','privileged role assignment','impersonation','activity from infrequent country','activity from anonymous','activity from suspicious','impossible travel activity']); let providerMatches = dynamic(['IPC','Azure Active Directory Identity Protection','MicrosoftCloudAppSecurity','Microsoft Cloud App Security','Office 365 Cloud App Security','Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps','Microsoft Entra ID Protection']); let excludeNames = dynamic(['phish','phishing','malware','virus','trojan','ransomware','suspicious url','url click','dropper','exploit kit','antivirus','endpoint','edr ','defender for endpoint','suspicious process']); SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) | extend an = tolower(tostring(AlertName)), pn = tostring(ProviderName), tac = tostring(Tactics) | where (pn in (providerMatches)) or (an has_any (nameMatches)) or (tac has 'CredentialAccess' and an !has 'malware') | where not(an has_any (excludeNames)) | extend ents = parse_json(Entities) | mv-expand e = ents | where tostring(e.Type) in ('account','Account') | extend uName = tostring(e.Name), uUpn = tostring(e.UPNSuffix), uAad = tostring(e.AadUserId) | extend user = case(isnotempty(uName) and isnotempty(uUpn), strcat(uName, '@', uUpn), isnotempty(uName), uName, isnotempty(uAad), uAad, 'unknown') | where user != 'unknown' and user != '' | summarize alertCount = count(), distinctAlertTypes = dcount(AlertName), topSeverity = tostring(arg_max(AlertSeverity, AlertName)), alertTitles = strcat_array(make_set(AlertName, 25), ' | '), lastSeen = format_datetime(max(TimeGenerated), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') by user | sort by alertCount desc | take 10

let lookback = 7d; let nameMatches = dynamic(['risky user','risky sign','sign-in from','sign in from','leaked credential','password spray','mfa fatigue','multi-factor authentication fatigue','atypical travel','impossible travel','anonymous ip','anonymous proxy','unfamiliar sign','unfamiliar location','unfamiliar properties','token theft','primary refresh token','aitm','adversary-in-the-middle','account takeover','suspicious inbox','inbox forwarding','inbox manipulation','suspicious oauth','consent to application','mass download','unusual file download','unusual administrative activity','suspicious addition to privileged','privileged role assignment','impersonation','activity from infrequent country','activity from anonymous','activity from suspicious','impossible travel activity']); let providerMatches = dynamic(['IPC','Azure Active Directory Identity Protection','MicrosoftCloudAppSecurity','Microsoft Cloud App Security','Office 365 Cloud App Security','Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps','Microsoft Entra ID Protection']); let excludeNames = dynamic(['phish','phishing','malware','virus','trojan','ransomware','suspicious url','url click','dropper','exploit kit','antivirus','endpoint','edr ','defender for endpoint','suspicious process']); SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback) | extend an = tolower(tostring(AlertName)), pn = tostring(ProviderName), tac = tostring(Tactics) | where (pn in (providerMatches)) or (an has_any (nameMatches)) or (tac has 'CredentialAccess' and an !has 'malware') | where not(an has_any (excludeNames)) | extend ents = parse_json(Entities) | mv-expand e = ents | where tostring(e.Type) in ('account','Account') | extend uName = tostring(e.Name), uUpn = tostring(e.UPNSuffix), uAad = tostring(e.AadUserId) | extend user = case(isnotempty(uName) and isnotempty(uUpn), strcat(uName, '@', uUpn), isnotempty(uName), uName, isnotempty(uAad), uAad, 'unknown') | where user != 'unknown' and user != '' | extend severity = tostring(AlertSeverity), severityRank = case(tolower(severity) == 'high', 3, tolower(severity) == 'medium', 2, tolower(severity) == 'low', 1, 0) | summarize alertCount = count(), topSeverity = tostring(arg_max(severityRank, severity)), lastSeen = format_datetime(max(TimeGenerated), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') by user, alertName = tostring(AlertName) | sort by alertCount desc, lastSeen desc | take 100

compute.expr: $type(fetched_sources.userSummary) = 'array' and fetched_sources.userSummary[0].user ? { "title": "Possibly compromised users (7d)", "value": $count(fetched_sources.userSummary), "detail": $sum(fetched_sources.userSummary.alertCount) & ' compromise alerts across ' & $count(fetched_sources.userSummary) & ' users' } : { "title": "Possibly compromised users (7d)", "value": 0, "detail": $type(fetched_sources.userSummary) = 'string' or $type(fetched_sources.alertDetails) = 'string' ? 'Sentinel query failed. See error below.' : 'No suspected-compromise alerts in window' }

$type(fetched_sources.userSummary) = 'string' ? '**Sentinel query failed:** ' & fetched_sources.userSummary : $type(fetched_sources.alertDetails) = 'string' ? '**Sentinel query failed:** ' & fetched_sources.alertDetails : ''
